skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractions and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Handle whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate, subtract, and recombine whole-number parts in mixed-number or whole-number subtraction, including treating missing whole or fractional parts as zero.

skills.name: Borrow from a whole number
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fractions when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify the result
skills.definition: Express the final answer in simplest form by reducing fractional parts or eliminating a zero fractional part when the result is an integer.
